How to use

  • Warm between the palms until liquid, then use as a body or hair oil.
  • Use as a dilution base — 12 drops per 30 ml gives 2%.
  • Massage into lengths and ends an hour before washing hair.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

Scent profile

  • Sweet coconut
  • Rich
  • Softening

What's in it

  • 100% cold-pressed Cocos nucifera kernel oil

Who it's for

Hair oiling

The traditional Indian hair oil, and still the one most households reach for.

Body use after a bath

Rich enough to work on dry skin, and it melts on contact.

Anyone who likes the smell

Unlike our other carriers this one has a scent, and it is a large part of the appeal.

What people get wrong

Expecting it to stay liquid. It sets solid below roughly 24°C, which in a Delhi winter means a cloudy, hard bottle. Warming it in your hands or in a bowl of hot water is all it needs.

Using it on acne-prone skin without testing. Coconut oil is comedogenic for a meaningful number of people — fine on bodies and hair, less reliably fine on faces.

What it won't do

It has a definite coconut smell, so it is not neutral the way jojoba is. In a blend it contributes rather than just carrying.

We do not stock the fractionated version, which stays liquid and is odourless. This is the ordinary cold-pressed oil.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Coconut Carrier Oil

Why does it go solid?

Coconut oil is high in saturated fats with a melting point around 24°C. Below that it crystallises. It is not a fault and it does not affect the oil — warm the bottle and it returns to liquid.

Can I use it on my face?

Some people can, some cannot. It is rated fairly high for comedogenicity, so patch-test over a few days before using it broadly. Jojoba or grapeseed is the safer facial choice.

How long does it keep once opened?

Around a year for a cold-pressed oil like this one — less in a warm bathroom. Keep the cap tight and store it somewhere cool and dark. If it starts to smell like old crayons, it has turned and should not go on skin.

Do I need to dilute it?

No — this is the carrier. It goes on neat, or it is what you dilute essential oils into. For a 2% blend, add about 12 drops of essential oil per 30 ml.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
